name: Dole Whip
review: The classic pineapple soft-serve that never disappoints. Cold, tangy, and the perfect reset between rides.

name: Mickey-shaped Pretzel
review: Warm, salty, and properly shaped. Cheese dip is optional but recommended after a long morning.

name: Be Our Guest Restaurant
review: The ballroom atmosphere is the real draw. Grey stuff is fine; the roast and the setting make the meal.

name: Cabanas Buffet
review: Reliable morning fuel with solid eggs, fruit, and the occasional surprise pastry. Good for groups with different preferences.

name: Churro with Chocolate
review: Crispy outside, soft inside, and the chocolate dip is non-negotiable. Best shared while walking.

name: Palo
review: Adult-only Italian with proper pasta and a view. Worth the reservation and the dress code.
